authorization.request: any User Stories which are in Review, please move to Done, me and GC have reviewed. Leave any Bugs in In Review and we'll look separately
authorization.basis: Direct collaborator acceptance after review with GC.
authorization.scope: Only native Story issues currently In Review are authorised for native Done. Bugs and all other issue types are excluded; the wider Jira write pause remains.

source_query: project = FUCQ AND issuetype = Story AND status = "In Review" ORDER BY key ASC
